caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate creamer pitcher rendered in pencil with some graphite shading to suggest a metallic surface. The pitcher, centrally positioned, has a bulbous lower body with vertically fluted decorative grooves, a narrower neck, and a wide, scalloped rim with a spout on the left and a large, elaborately curved handle on the right. The handle features a twisted or braided detail. The base is circular and slightly raised, also decorated with grooves. Reflections and shadowing are used to indicate the shiny, reflective quality of the material, likely silver or metal, with the primary tones being shades of grey and some dark accents for depth. The drawing includes handwritten annotations to the lower right, reading: "CREAMER about 6 x 3 Ann. N. Wing. 24 Silver Gallery," and another smaller inscription "Buschly." The pitcher is set on a flat surface with a faint horizontal shadow beneath it, and the whole object is framed within a lightly drawn rectangular border on a beige, slightly textured background.
title: Silver Pitcher
